interpretation.success: Multi-cohort calibration restored low nuisance burden after challenge 004 while preserving the ~0.70 strict early-warning score seen in challenge 003. Fifty of 51 leak onsets had at least one alert within 10 half-hour steps.
interpretation.failure: The per-timestep state classifier remains unstable on leak duration/signature: recall is only 0.642 despite high precision. More threshold-only iterations are unlikely to be the highest-value next step.
interpretation.decision: Treat the alert detector as a credible development baseline for initiating localization work, while retaining state classification as supporting evidence rather than a production-ready leak-state estimator.
interpretation.next_iteration: Build a sealed localization benchmark: after a detected/known leak window, rank candidate network nodes/areas using sensor residuals and topology, with leak node labels kept in the secret artifact until rankings are frozen.
